findings.finding: Acting with remaining pose uncertainty when task success is adequate already exists. Success/robust selection, value of information, and a generic critic are not new contributions.
findings.consequence: Investigate shared-VLA action/pose success compatibility under matched labels against lookup, shared-support and separate classifier.

findings.finding: DISaM uses between-context distributional KL; identical multimodal distributions can have KL zero despite high action sample variance.
findings.consequence: C3 is a negative control, not a claimed DISaM failure.

findings.finding: FoundationPose stores all ranked poses/scores, but centered mesh frame differs from returned best-pose original mesh frame. Invalid-depth early return must invalidate stale candidates. Tracking is single-pose.
findings.consequence: Apply each center transform before camera-to-base; specify symmetry, valid mask, set coverage/update; do not treat ranking scores as probabilities.

findings.finding: Inspected l2l/robosuite camera path directly sets camera/mocap pose, not physical actuator motion with measured travel cost.
findings.consequence: Diagnostic virtual views and physical active perception must be separated; fixed view sequence can isolate stop/continue initially.

findings.finding: SpatialVLA exposes hidden-state and depth/XYZ features, but no pose-belief/camera-action input. Default predict_action is greedy and processor decodes first generated sequence.
findings.consequence: Proposal diversity/individual decoding/rescoring, normalization and action frame require an adapter; repeated greedy calls are not distinct proposals.

findings.finding: SquareNut has pose sensors, side handle and collision geometry. on_peg uses positional bounds; success also requires EEF separation, with no explicit yaw/contact predicate.
findings.consequence: Not yet a matched language-task evaluator or evidence of pose-ambiguous initial views, physical orientation success, or VLA competence.

findings.finding: Repeated generated candidates can be retained; inspected aggregation uses energy or uniform scores then selection/averaging.
findings.consequence: Do not infer calibrated posterior/likelihood export or checkpoint availability from inspected path.

findings.finding: TASK-GEOMETRY has an actual SpatialVLA depth intervention point, currently inside no_grad inference. POSE-ACTIVE needs candidate-pose labels and camera/belief adapters.
findings.consequence: Withdraw categorical claim that candidate 1 is cheaper/easier. Keep it selected for question decomposition; frozen-depth diagnostics for candidate 2 may be shorter. Candidate 2 full N1 not completed.
